scenarios.name: Switch between panels compacted by a narrow window

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full View ribbon displayed
the narrow window shows Appearance and Windows as compact panel buttons
the user clicks the Appearance panel button
the temporary Appearance panel opens below the ribbon
the user clicks the Windows panel button
the Appearance panel closes and the temporary Windows panel opens
the user clicks the Windows panel button again
the user clicks empty viewport space
